location_description: Endwell is a hamlet (and census-designated place) located in the town of Union in Broome County, New York, United States. Its population was 11,446 at the 2010 census.Endwell is situated between the villages of Endicott and Johnson City. It is west of Binghamton and is considered a suburb of that city.
